summary: Implemented unknown-total (None) Progress tasks in rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, docs/source/progress.rst and tests/test_progress.py. Added public TaskProgressColumn (TextColumn subclass), pulse for None totals, blank/"?" outputs for time-remaining, total-size, count and download columns, and None-safe Task remaining/time_remaining and finish detection. Test results: tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_bar.py all pass (including new unknown-total tests and the pulse reference render). Full suite: 13 failures in test_card, test_markdown, test_syntax and test_traceback, identical to the original tree before my changes. tests/test_pretty.py cannot be collected because the shared venv lacks 'attr'; I did not install it. Black is not in the venv, so formatting was done by hand and not verified with the tool. Nothing was committed.
